title: Why sleep is the first thing we ask about
excerpt: Tiredness, low mood, headaches and raised blood pressure often share one cause. A few questions about your nights can save a lot of tests.
content:
Tiredness, low mood, headaches and raised blood pressure often share one cause. Before we order tests, we ask how you sleep, because the answer changes what we look for.

Three questions we will ask

  • How long does it take you to fall asleep?
  • How often do you wake in the night?
  • Do you feel rested when you get up?

What usually helps first

Regular hours, less screen light in the last hour of the evening and less caffeine after midday help more people than tablets do. If they do not help within a few weeks, that is worth a conversation.

This article is general information and not personal medical advice. If you are worried about your health, please make an appointment.
